assessments.name: Workshop Participation
assessments.description: Students are encouraged to actively participate in workshop interactions, such as answering questions. Workshop participation contributions will be recorded after class, totaling 5 points.

assessments.name: Individual Academic Writing
assessments.description: Thematic literature review of a topic related to project initiation.

assessments.name: Individual Reflection - Learning Journal
assessments.description: Students must maintain weekly learning journals (weeks 1-10), reflecting on the assigned readings on Canvas, insights gained from the class, and any other relevant reflections for the week.

assessments.name: Group Presentation - Comprehensive Project Initiation Plan
assessments.description: Student groups will present their comprehensive project initiation plan for a real-world cases (completed or ongoing projects) or conceptual project initiation (projects you would like to initiate).
assessments.length: Presentation and Q&A (25 mins per group)

assessments.name: small quizzes
assessments.description: Short in-class quizzes will be conducted during each workshop to assess attendance and students’ understanding of key concepts.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test
